meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里装上固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI,让 agent 把附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档在容器内转成 Markdown,不上传到托管解析器。它会复制技能文件、写入版本清单、重建镜像并重启服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档,又不希望把文件上传到托管解析器时,由这个技能接管安装。

say.text: 把这个技能的 AnyDoc CLI 装到我的 NanoClaw 容器里
say.note: 会复制技能文件、写入清单并重建镜像

say.text: 重启 NanoClaw 服务,让新技能在下次启动时生效

howto.what_en: Installs the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI into NanoClaw agent containers. Agents can convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and other office files to Markdown locally without uploading them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Install the AnyDoc CLI into my NanoClaw container
say_en.note: Copies skill files, updates the manifest, rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Check that @firecrawl/anydoc 0.1.6 passes the 72-hour release gate
say_en.note: Queries the npm registry and stops on failure.

say_en.text: Restart the NanoClaw service so the new skill takes effect
say_en.note: Restarts only this install's NanoClaw service.
